text:
The decision to put words in front of readers stays with a person. Every article goes through the shared article review and a human approval, and TextOS publishes nothing automatically. What this workflow removes is the retyping and the guesswork about which changes are worth a line; what it keeps is your judgment on each topic.

The scope today is deliberately small: TextOS currently reads only its own repository. If you assess this kind of workflow for your own product, expect to spend your time accepting or refusing proposals, not writing them.
